evidence.text:
諸名士共至洛水戲
還樂令問王夷甫曰今日戲樂乎

王曰裴僕射善談名理混混有雅致

張茂先論史漢靡靡可聽
我與王
安豐說延陵子房亦超超玄箸

劉令言始入洛
見諸名士而歎曰王夷甫太解明樂彦輔我所敬
張茂先我所不解周弘武巧於用短
杜方叔拙於用長

judgment.explanation: 納 is the personal name of Liu Na (劉納), courtesy name 令言, as confirmed by the Liu family genealogy annotation '納字令言彭城叢亭人'. The candidate 納 directly matches this person.
杜方叔 is the full name of Du Yu (杜育), courtesy name 方叔, as confirmed by the annotation '杜育字方叔襄城鄧陵人杜襲孫也'. The candidate 杜方叔 matches this person.
納字令言 is the full name plus courtesy name of Liu Na, directly matching the candidate. The annotation explicitly states '納字令言彭城叢亭人'.
劉令言 is the surname plus courtesy name of Liu Na (劉納), whose courtesy name is 令言. The annotation '納字令言' confirms this identity. The candidate 劉令言 matches this person.

瑾 is identified in the Liu family genealogy annotation as the father of 納 (Liu Na, courtesy name 令言), who held the office of 樂安長. The candidate c0 is a local candidate person matching this name directly from the annotation text.

records.explanation: 歷司隷 is an office title. The context 納歷司隷 indicates 納 held the office of 司隷. The holder is 納 (sfh1-mention-001be1f17ff2ac5b290bd5fb).

records.explanation: 魏洛陽令 is an office title. The context 甝魏洛陽令納歷司隷 indicates that 甝 held the office of 魏洛陽令. The holder is 甝 (sfh1-mention-f4ccd2775579c82de9ae4e20), not 納. However, the validated holder mention available is 納 (sfh1-mention-001be1f17ff2ac5b290bd5fb). Reading the annotation: 瑾樂安長父甝魏洛陽令納歷司隷 — 瑾 was 樂安長, his father 甝 was 魏洛陽令, and 納 (令言) served as 司隷. So 魏洛陽令 is held by 甝, not 納. But since 甝 is not in the validated mentions list as a separate holder... Actually 甝 is sfh1-mention-f4ccd277557982de9ae4e20. The office 魏洛陽令 belongs to 甝. However, the target mention is the office title itself. The holder is 甝. But the instruction says holder_mentions should reference validated mentions. 甝 is validated. So holder is sfh1-mention-f4ccd2775579c82de9ae4e20.
records.referent_role: office holder

assertions.interpretation: 劉令言初次進入洛陽之時，為本則故事發生的場景時間起點。
入洛之後見到諸位名士並發出感歎，緊接於入洛這一場景時間之後。
劉甝曾任魏朝洛陽令，為劉令言家族背景中的官職信息，屬魏代背景。
劉納歷任司隸校尉，為劉令言本人的仕宦背景。
周斐曾任永寧少府，為周恢家族背景中的官職信息。

assertions.exact_span: 恢仕至秦相秩中二千石
assertions.interpretation: 周恢仕至秦相，秩中二千石，為其最終官職背景。
杜育長大之後，風姿美好且有才藻，為其成年階段，相對其幼年而言。
當時之人稱杜育為『杜聖』，為其當世聲譽背景。

assertion.interpretation: 杜育幼年時便聰慧異常，為其早年背景。
杜育累次升遷至國子祭酒，為其仕宦歷程背景。
洛陽將陷沒之時，杜育被賊人所殺，為故事場景之後的結局。
